name: infosteed
description: Self-hosted Chromium workflow recorder, guide editor, and video production suite.

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter './packages/**' build && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
scripts.notices:generate: corepack pnpm licenses list --prod --json > .notices-inventory.json && NOTICE_INVENTORY_FILE=.notices-inventory.json node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs && rm -f .notices-inventory.json
scripts.notices:check: corepack pnpm licenses list --prod --json > .notices-inventory.json && NOTICE_INVENTORY_FILE=.notices-inventory.json node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs --check && rm -f .notices-inventory.json
